newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ROBSON GIVES UP ON NADAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROBSON GIVES UP ON NADAL.

text.p: Bryan Robson, the manager of premier league bottom club Middlesbrough, conceded on Thursday that he has no chance of signing coveted Barcelona defender Miguel Angel Nadal.

It was the latest setback in a bad week for the Boro boss, whose side are now four points adrift in the league after having three points deducted this week for unilaterally calling off a league match at Blackburn last month.
They were stung further when striker Fabrizio Ravenelli criticised the club in an Italian interview.

Robson wanted central defender Nadal, who earned the nickname "The Beast of Barcelona" during last year's European Championships, to shore up his leaky defence. But he feels Barcelona moved the goalposts by declaring Nadal unavailable.
Manchester United had earlier abandoned their attempts to sign the Spaniard when negotiations broke down after financial terms had virtually been agreed.

On the positive side, Boro's new 2.7 million pounds ($4.45 million) defensive signing from Inter Milan, Gianluca Festa, should make his debut with the club in the premier league home clash against Sheffield Wednesday on Saturday.
The club have also secured a work permit for Slovakian defender Vladimir Kinder.
